# graylog_stream (Resource)

Manages a Graylog stream. Streams route messages into categories based on rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_stream" "application_logs" {
  title                              = "Application Logs"
  description                        = "All application log messages"
  index_set_id                       = "000000000000000000000001"
  matching_type                      = "AND"
  remove_matches_from_default_stream = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_set_id` (String) The ID of the index set this stream writes to.
- `title` (String) The stream title.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the stream.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the stream is disabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `matching_type` (String) How stream rules are evaluated: `AND` (all must match) or `OR` (any must match). Defaults to `AND`.
- `remove_matches_from_default_stream` (Boolean) Remove messages that match this stream from the default stream. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stream ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graylog_stream.application_logs 69babedb10ce598257cccd2c
```
